analysis.methods: The study involved generating mice with Treg-specific conditional knockout (cKO) of IRF2 and infecting them with chronic LCMV to assess Treg activity and immune responses. Additionally, mouse melanoma models were employed to investigate the role of IRF2 in cancer.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of IRF2 deletion in regulatory T cells (Tregs) in enhancing anti-viral and anti-tumor immune responses. Using Treg-specific conditional knockout (cKO) mice infected with chronic lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) and melanoma models, the researchers found that IRF2 deletion abolished Treg numbers, increased IFN-I signaling, and enhanced effector CD8 and CD4 T cell responses. While this led to improved viral control and tumor survival in mice, the study's reliance on animal models limits direct human applicability. The findings suggest IRF2 as a potential checkpoint for modulating immune responses in chronic infections and cancer.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: T 调节细胞 (Treg) 对于限制免疫病理学至关重要,但它们也可以在慢性感染和癌症期间发挥免疫威慑作用。干扰素调节因子 2 (IRF2) 是一种转录因子,可负向调节 I 型干扰素 (IFN-I) 信号传导,在应对病毒感染时,Treg 会整合 IFN-I 信号以限制其活性并实现 抗病毒药物 免疫。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 为了了解 IRF2 在慢性感染期间如何改变 Treg 活性,该研究培育了 IRF2 Treg 特异性条件敲除 (cKO) 小鼠,并用慢性 淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒 (LCMV) 感染它们。小鼠黑色素瘤模型也被用来研究其在癌症中的作用。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究涉及产生 IRF2 Treg 特异性条件敲除 (cKO) 小鼠,并用慢性 LCMV 感染它们,以评估 Treg 活性和 免疫应答。此外,还利用小鼠黑色素瘤模型来研究 IRF2 在癌症中的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 感染后,cKO 小鼠中的 Treg 数量几乎完全消失,剩下的少数 Treg 表现出高 IFN-I 信号传导和激活的表型。Tregs 缺乏 IRF2 表达会减少 CD8 T 前体耗尽 (Tpex) 细胞,并增加效应病毒特异性 CD8 T 细胞的数量和功能活性。cKO 小鼠还具有更多功能性病毒特异性 CD4 T 细胞,在慢性感染期间倾向于 Th1 分化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,IRF2 是 Tregs 中平衡 IFN-I 信号传导的关键检查点,对免疫介导的慢性感染和癌症控制具有重要意义。新颖之处在于证明Tregs中IRF2缺失增强了免疫应答的抗病毒和抗肿瘤能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对 Tregs 中的 IRF2 可能是增强 免疫应答 对抗慢性病毒感染和癌症的策略,可能为这些疾病提供新的治疗方法。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在小鼠模型中进行的,这可能会限制直接转化为人类。证据强度中等,因为该研究提供了机制见解,但需要在人类环境中进一步验证。

papers.title: Differentiation, programming, and (dys)functions of cytotoxic CD4 T cells in acute and chronic viral infection 2257364
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Killing of virus infected cells is associated with CD8 cytotoxic T lymphocytes (CTL) and NK cells; however, CD4 T cells can also exhibit cytotoxic properties. In response to viral infections and cancers, cells downregulate MHC-I but maintain MHC-II, thereby preventing CD8-CTL killing and enabling CD4-CTL targeting. Further, CD8-CTL are functionally exhausted during chronic infections, limiting their ability to kill and providing a potential role for CD4-CTL in controlling infection. Immune activity and effector cell differentiation mediated by antigen presenting cells (APC) can also potentially be modulated by CD4-CTL targeting. We have identified cytotoxic activity as a main CD4 T cell function restored by anti-PD-L1 during chronic LCMV infection. Conversely, the role of CD4-CTL in acute infections is unclear. Methods We used two strains of Lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV), Armstrong and Clone 13, to study the role of cytotoxic CD4 in acute and chronic viral infections in mice. Results In acute lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) infection, we demonstrate that CD4-CTL are restricted to the Th1 subset, are associated with the highest level of metabolic and functional activation, and have a distinct transcriptional and epigenetic profile compared to non-CTL Th1 cells. Interestingly, the initial CD4-CTL response forms the basis for maintaining long-term CD4 CTL-reactivatable memory following rechallenge. In vivo, CD4-CTL target B cells via MHC-II in a perforin-dependent manner, and we are exploring a potential role of CD4-CTL to tune B cell immunity and enable a focused immune response. Interestingly, during chronic LCMV infection, alterations in transcriptional programming restrict the induction of CD4-CTL, despite the presence of Th1 cells, underpinning a previously unrecognized quality of CD4 T cell exhaustion. Conclusion Together, my findings provide fundamental insights into the role of CD4-CTL in shaping the antiviral immune response in both acute and chronic infection. Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Viral Immunology (VIR)

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the differentiation, programming, and functions of cytotoxic CD4 T cells in acute and chronic viral infections, focusing on their role in antiviral immunity and potential therapeutic implications.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used two strains of Lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV), Armstrong and Clone 13, to examine the role of cytotoxic CD4 T cells in acute and chronic viral infections in mice.
analysis.methods: The researchers analyzed the transcriptional and epigenetic profiles of CD4-CTL, assessed their metabolic and functional activation, and evaluated their targeting of B cells via MHC-II in a perforin-dependent manner during LCMV infection.
analysis.main_results: In acute LCMV infection, CD4-CTL were restricted to the Th1 subset, exhibited high metabolic and functional activation, and had a distinct transcriptional and epigenetic profile compared to non-CTL Th1 cells. During chronic infection, alterations in transcriptional programming restricted the induction of CD4-CTL despite the presence of Th1 cells.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provide fundamental insights into the role of CD4-CTL in shaping the antiviral immune response in both acute and chronic infections, revealing a previously unrecognized quality of CD4 T cell exhaustion during chronic infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the potential of CD4-CTL as a therapeutic target, particularly in chronic infections where CD8-CTL are functionally exhausted, and suggests their role in modulating B cell immunity to enable a focused immune response.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in a mouse model using LCMV strains, which may limit generalizability to human infections or other viral pathogens. The evidence strength is moderate due to the focused model system and the need for further validation in human studies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of cytotoxic CD4 T cells (CD4-CTL) in acute and chronic viral infections using LCMV in mice. In acute infection, CD4-CTL are restricted to the Th1 subset, exhibit high metabolic activation, and have distinct transcriptional profiles. They target B cells via MHC-II in a perforin-dependent manner and form the basis for long-term memory. In chronic infection, transcriptional alterations restrict CD4-CTL induction, revealing a new aspect of CD4 T cell exhaustion. The findings suggest CD4-CTL as a potential therapeutic target, particularly when CD8-CTL are exhausted, and highlight their role in modulating B cell immunity for focused immune responses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究细胞毒性 CD4 T 细胞在急性和慢性病毒感染中的分化、编程和功能,重点关注它们在 抗病毒药物 免疫中的作用和潜在的治疗意义。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了 淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒 (LCMV) 的两种毒株:阿姆斯特朗 (Armstrong) 和克隆 13,来研究细胞毒性 CD4 T 细胞在小鼠急性和慢性病毒感染中的作用。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员分析了 CD4-CTL 的转录和表观遗传图谱,评估了它们的代谢和功能激活,并评估了它们在 LCMV 感染期间以穿孔素依赖性方式通过 MHC-II 对 B 细胞的靶向作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 在急性 LCMV 感染中,CD4-CTL 仅限于 Th1 亚群,表现出高代谢和功能激活,并且与非 CTL Th1 细胞相比具有独特的转录和表观遗传特征。在慢性感染期间,尽管存在 Th1 细胞,但转录编程的改变限制了 CD4-CTL 的诱导。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为 CD4-CTL 在急性和慢性感染中形成 抗病毒药物 免疫应答 的作用提供了基本见解,揭示了慢性感染期间 CD4 T 细胞耗竭的先前未被认识的质量。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究强调了 CD4-CTL 作为治疗靶点的潜力,特别是在 CD8-CTL 功能耗尽的慢性感染中,并表明它们在调节 B 细胞免疫以实现集中的 免疫应答 方面的作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在使用 LCMV 毒株的小鼠模型中进行的,这可能会限制其对人类感染或其他病毒病原体的普遍适用性。由于重点模型系统和需要在人体研究中进一步验证,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究细胞毒性 CD4 T 细胞在急性和慢性病毒感染中的分化、编程和功能,重点关注它们在 抗病毒药物 免疫中的作用和潜在的治疗意义。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了 淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒 (LCMV) 的两种毒株:阿姆斯特朗 (Armstrong) 和克隆 13,来研究细胞毒性 CD4 T 细胞在小鼠急性和慢性病毒感染中的作用。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员分析了 CD4-CTL 的转录和表观遗传图谱,评估了它们的代谢和功能激活,并评估了它们在 LCMV 感染期间以穿孔素依赖性方式通过 MHC-II 对 B 细胞的靶向作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在急性 LCMV 感染中,CD4-CTL 仅限于 Th1 亚群,表现出高代谢和功能激活,并且与非 CTL Th1 细胞相比具有独特的转录和表观遗传特征。在慢性感染期间,尽管存在 Th1 细胞,但转录编程的改变限制了 CD4-CTL 的诱导。

papers.title: Prior antigen experience influences the development of alopecia areata in C3H/HeJ mice 2258436
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Alopecia areata (AA) is an autoimmune disease of the hair follicle (HF) with a 2% lifetime incidence, characterized by well-defined patches of hair loss on the scalp. AA arises from the breakdown of HF immune privilege, leading to T cell infiltration and attack of the HF. Unlike humans who are continually exposed to diverse microbes, laboratory mice are maintained under specific pathogen—free (SPF) conditions, limiting their immune experience. Recent studies have shown that pet-store mice more closely replicate human immune responses. C3H/HeJ (C3H) mice are a common model to study AA and can be induced using skin grafts from affected mice; however, these mice are typically maintained in SPF facilities. This study aimed to determine whether immunologically experienced C3H mice, induced to develop AA, would harbor a skin environment that more closely mimics human patients. Methods To test this, we generated mice using a sequential infection model, replicating findings in pet-store mice, by infecting C3H mice with influenza A virus, vaccinia virus, Listeria monocytogenes, and lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus Armstrong at 5-day intervals. Results Sequentially infected mice, before disease induction, exhibited increased frequencies of antigen-experienced CD8 T cells in blood and skin-draining lymph nodes (SDLNs) compared to non-infected mice. They also showed elevated NKG2D+ CD8 T cells, a population known to drive AA. We hypothesized that AA onset would be accelerated following skin-graft induction. Surprisingly, previously infected mice developed AA at a reduced rate and exhibited fewer AA-associated T cells in SDLNs and skin compared to controls. Conclusion Ongoing studies will determine whether sequential infections alter precursor frequency of autoimmune T cells. Together, these data suggest that prior microbial exposure reshapes the immune landscape in C3H mice, attenuating AA-specific immune responses and supporting future studies to dissect how infections influence AA development. Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Basic Autoimmunity (BA)

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究的目的是确定经过免疫学处理的 C3H 小鼠在被诱导发展为斑秃后,是否会拥有更接近人类患者的皮肤环境。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用斑秃常见模型C3H/HeJ小鼠,并通过以5天的间隔用甲型流感病毒、牛痘病毒、单核细胞增生李斯特菌和淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒阿姆斯特朗感染,使用序贯感染模型生成小鼠。
elements_zh.methods: 在通过皮肤移植诱导疾病之前,将连续感染的小鼠与未感染的小鼠进行比较,以评估血液和皮肤引流淋巴结中经历过抗原的 CD8 T 细胞以及 NKG2D+ CD8 T 细胞的频率。
elements_zh.main_results: 连续感染的小鼠表现出抗原经历的 CD8 T 细胞频率增加和 NKG2D+ CD8 T 细胞升高,但与对照组相比,斑秃发生率降低,皮肤引流淋巴结和皮肤中 AA 相关 T 细胞较少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,之前的微生物暴露重塑了 C3H 小鼠的免疫景观,减弱了 AA 特异性 免疫应答,并支持未来的研究来剖析感染如何影响 AA 的发展。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,先前的抗原经历会影响自身免疫性疾病的发展,可能有助于了解微生物暴露如何在斑秃等自身免疫性疾病中调节 免疫应答。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究基于小鼠模型,并且需要正在进行的研究来确定连续感染是否会改变自身免疫 T 细胞的前体频率。

papers.title: Viral (LCMV) coinfection decreases the number of pathogenic Th17 cells in the CNS and prevents demyelinating disease 2309860
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Multiple sclerosis is a chronic autoimmune demyelinating disease impacting 2.9 million people worldwide. Despite the significant advances in understanding the pathogenicity of CD4+ T cells, there is no cure. Infections have often been considered a trigger for the development of autoimmune diseases, yet infections can also have potential protective roles. Here, we investigate the impact of viral co-infection on demyelinating disease. Methods We found that infecting C57Bl/6 mice with lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) during experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) leads to complete protection from demyelinating disease onset and progressive paralysis compared to uninfected controls. Results Overall, there was a substantial decrease in the numbers of pathogenic Th17 CD4 T cells. Using 2D-micropipette adhesion frequency assay, we demonstrated reduction in the overall number of myelin specific T cells and their affinity for MOG35-55. In adoptive transfer experiments, LCMV infection also prevented demyelinating disease induced by 2D2 TCR Tg CD4+ T cells. While viral coinfection prevented disease, Type I interferon was not the causative mechanism. Conclusion Our work indicates that viral co-infection can decrease the number and affinity of pathogenic, myelin specific CD4 T cells in the CNS. Funding Source NA Topic Categories Neuroimmunology (NEUR)

papers.title: Distinct tissue niches contribute to prostate tissue-resident memory T cell differentiation and heterogeneity 2256438
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction The prostate is an exocrine organ, a barrier tissue to the male reproductive system, and a site of malignancy, yet prostate tissue-resident memory T cells and the unique cues in the tissue environment remain unexplored. Methods To study T cell memory formation in the prostate, we utilized acute systemic viral infection with lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) Armstrong, which has been used to study CD8+ tissue-resident memory T cells in a broad range of other tissues. To further characterize this population, we employed genetic mouse models, scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics to investigate antigen-specific prostate tissue-resident memory T cell formation, differentiation, and heterogeneity. Results Acute infection generated a population of long-lived CD8+ T cells with characteristics of tissue residency. These prostate tissue-resident memory T cells protect against reinfection and display functional and phenotypic heterogeneity in both mice and humans. Functional interrogation of TGFβ-, IL-7-, and IL-15-derived signals reveal subset-specific prostate tissue-resident memory T cell dependencies according to their niche-dependent phenotypes and distinct cytokine sources. For instance, tissue-resident memory-promoting cytokines IL-15 and TGFβ are highest in the prostate epithelium where CD8+ T cells are most enriched for tissue-resident memory-associated gene expression and analysis of human prostate samples identified similar patterns of both cytokine and CD8+ T cell localization. Conclusion We define a spatial framework of heterogenous T cell residence in the prostate, with prostate tissue-resident memory T cell heterogeneity being spatially segregated based on discrete cytokine and chemokine niches, with divergence of T cell transcriptional states between T cells localized to the stromal versus epithelial regions in both mice and humans Funding Source F31AI176705 Topic Categories Mucosal and Regional Immunology (MUC)

To further characterize this population, we employed genetic mouse models, scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics to investigate antigen-specific prostate tissue-resident memory T cell formation, differentiation, and heterogeneity. Acute infection generated a population of long-lived CD8+ T cells with characteristics of tissue residency. These prostate tissue-resident memory T cells protect against reinfection and display functional and phenotypic heterogeneity in both mice and humans. Functional interrogation of TGFβ-, IL-7-, and IL-15-derived signals reveal subset-specific prostate tissue-resident memory T cell dependencies according to their niche-dependent phenotypes and distinct cytokine sources. For instance, tissue-resident memory-promoting cytokines IL-15 and TGFβ are highest in the prostate epithelium where CD8+ T cells are most enriched for tissue-resident memory-associated gene expression and analysis of human prostate samples identified similar patterns of both cytokine and CD8+ T cell localization. We define a spatial framework of heterogenous T cell residence in the prostate, with prostate tissue-resident memory T cell heterogeneity being spatially segregated based on discrete cytokine and chemokine niches, with divergence of T cell transcriptional states between T cells localized to the stromal versus epithelial regions in both mice and humans F31AI176705 Mucosal and Regional Immunology (MUC)

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated prostate tissue-resident memory T cells and their heterogeneity using acute systemic viral infection with LCMV Armstrong in mice. Employing genetic models, scRNA-seq, and spatial transcriptomics, the researchers identified long-lived CD8+ T cells with tissue residency characteristics that protect against reinfection and exhibit functional and phenotypic heterogeneity in both mice and humans. The findings reveal a spatial framework where T cell heterogeneity is segregated based on discrete cytokine and chemokine niches, with divergent transcriptional states in stromal versus epithelial regions, validated in human samples. This work advances understanding of prostate immunology and may inform immunotherapeutic strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 前列腺是外分泌器官、男性生殖系统的屏障组织和恶性肿瘤发生部位,但前列腺组织驻留的记忆 T 细胞和组织环境中的独特线索仍未被探索。方法 为了研究前列腺中 T 细胞记忆的形成,我们利用 淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒 (LCMV) Armstrong 的急性全身病毒感染,该病毒已用于研究广泛其他组织中的 CD8+ 组织驻留记忆 T 细胞。为了进一步表征该群体,我们采用遗传小鼠模型、scRNA-seq 和空间转录组学来研究抗原特异性前列腺组织驻留记忆 T 细胞的形成、分化和异质性。结果急性感染产生了一群具有组织驻留特征的长寿命 CD8+ T 细胞。这些前列腺组织驻留的记忆 T 细胞可防止再感染,并在小鼠和人类中表现出功能和表型异质性。对 TGFβ、IL-7 和 IL-15 衍生信号的功能性询问揭示了根据其生态位依赖性表型和不同细胞因子来源的子集特异性前列腺组织驻留记忆 T 细胞依赖性。例如,组织驻留记忆促进细胞因子 IL-15 和 TGFβ 在前列腺上皮中含量最高,其中 CD8+ T 细胞在组织驻留记忆相关基因表达方面最为富集,并且对人类前列腺样本的分析发现了细胞因子和 CD8+ T 细胞定位的相似模式。结论 我们定义了前列腺中异质 T 细胞驻留的空间框架,前列腺组织驻留记忆 T 细胞异质性基于离散的细胞因子和趋化因子生态位进行空间隔离,小鼠和人类中位于基质与上皮区域的 T 细胞之间的 T 细胞转录状态存在差异 资金来源 F31AI176705 主题类别 粘膜和区域免疫学 (MUC)

papers.title: Long-distance communication between CD8 T cells and brainstem neurons determines sickness behaviors and infection outcome 2254620
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction CD8 T cells are classically known for their cytotoxic role in eliminating infected, cancerous, and damaged cells. However, their potential for non-cytotoxic, long-distance, and bidirectional communication with neurons has remained unexplored. Methods Mice were intravenously infected with lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus Clone 13, as a natural model of a sustained viral infection. We combined behavioral assays, immunohistochemistry, pharmacological blockade, stereotactic ablation of specific brain neurons, flow cytometry, and single-cell RNA sequencing to dissect how CD8 T cells and neurons bidirectionally communicate during viral infection. Results Depletion of CD8 T cells abolished sickness behaviors observed one week after a systemic viral infection, while adoptive transfer of CD8 T cells into T cell and B cell-deficient mice restored these behaviors. Blocking CD8 T cell brain entry did not affect behaviors. Whole-brain c-Fos mapping revealed CD8 T cell-dependent activation of caudal nucleus of solitary tract (cNTS), including dopamine β-hydroxylase—positive (DBH+) neurons, at the peak of sickness behaviors. Ablation of these neurons attenuated sickness behaviors and enhanced effector-like CD8 T-cell responses in spleen, lung, and blood. Single-cell RNA sequencing uncovered an unconventional CD8 T cell subset co-expressing TCR-α, β, and γ chains, and enriched for IL-2 signature and cytotoxic genes following the neuronal ablation. Although viral loads decreased, the neuronal ablation caused severe, CD8 T cell-dependent, lung hemorrhage and increased mortality. Conclusion Our findings reveal a previously unrecognized systemic feedback loop wherein CD8 T cells remotely activate cNTS DBH+ neurons without entering the brain. These neurons not only drive sickness behaviors but also restrain CD8 T cell effector functions to prevent fatal immunopathology, at the expense of viral control. This immune—neural axis integrates host behavior and antiviral immunity into a single regulatory circuit. Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Neuroimmunology (NEUR)

papers.title_zh: CD8 T 细胞和脑干神经元之间的长距离通信决定疾病行为和感染结果 2254620
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction CD8 T cells are classically known for their cytotoxic role in eliminating infected, cancerous, and damaged cells. However, their potential for non-cytotoxic, long-distance, and bidirectional communication with neurons has remained unexplored. Methods Mice were intravenously infected with lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus Clone 13, as a natural model of a sustained viral infection. We combined behavioral assays, immunohistochemistry, pharmacological blockade, stereotactic ablation of specific brain neurons, flow cytometry, and single-cell RNA sequencing to dissect how CD8 T cells and neurons bidirectionally communicate during viral infection. Results Depletion of CD8 T cells abolished sickness behaviors observed one week after a systemic viral infection, while adoptive transfer of CD8 T cells into T cell and B cell-deficient mice restored these behaviors. Blocking CD8 T cell brain entry did not affect behaviors. Whole-brain c-Fos mapping revealed CD8 T cell-dependent activation of caudal nucleus of solitary tract (cNTS), including dopamine β-hydroxylase—positive (DBH+) neurons, at the peak of sickness behaviors. Ablation of these neurons attenuated sickness behaviors and enhanced effector-like CD8 T-cell responses in spleen, lung, and blood. Single-cell RNA sequencing uncovered an unconventional CD8 T cell subset co-expressing TCR-α, β, and γ chains, and enriched for IL-2 signature and cytotoxic genes following the neuronal ablation. Although viral loads decreased, the neuronal ablation caused severe, CD8 T cell-dependent, lung hemorrhage and increased mortality. Conclusion Our findings reveal a previously unrecognized systemic feedback loop wherein CD8 T cells remotely activate cNTS DBH+ neurons without entering the brain. These neurons not only drive sickness behaviors but also restrain CD8 T cell effector functions to prevent fatal immunopathology, at the expense of viral control. This immune—neural axis integrates host behavior and antiviral immunity into a single regulatory circuit. Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Neuroimmunology (NEUR)
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 CD8 T 细胞因其消除感染、癌变和受损细胞的细胞毒作用而闻名。然而,它们与神经元的非细胞毒性、长距离和双向通信的潜力尚未被探索。方法小鼠静脉注射淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒克隆13,作为持续病毒感染的自然模型。我们结合了行为测定、免疫组织化学、药理学阻断、特定脑神经元的立体定向消融、流式细胞术和单细胞 RNA 测序来剖析 CD8 T 细胞和神经元在病毒感染期间如何双向通信。结果 CD8 T 细胞的耗竭消除了全身病毒感染一周后观察到的疾病行为,而将 CD8 T 细胞过继转移到 T 细胞和 B 细胞缺陷小鼠体内则恢复了这些行为。阻断 CD8 T 细胞进入大脑不会影响行为。全脑 c-Fos 图谱显示,在疾病行为高峰期,孤束尾核 (cNTS) 存在 CD8 T 细胞依赖性激活,包括多巴胺 β-羟化酶阳性 (DBH+) 神经元。这些神经元的消融减轻了疾病行为并增强了脾、肺和血液中的效应样 CD8 T 细胞反应。单细胞 RNA 测序发现了一个非常规的 CD8 T 细胞亚群,共表达 TCR-α、β 和 γ 链,并在神经元消融后富集了 IL-2 特征和细胞毒性基因。尽管病毒载量减少,但神经元消融导致严重的 CD8 T 细胞依赖性肺出血和 死亡率 增加。结论 我们的研究结果揭示了一个以前未被认识的系统反馈回路,其中 CD8 T 细胞在不进入大脑的情况下远程激活 cNTS DBH+ 神经元。这些神经元不仅会导致疾病行为,还会抑制 CD8 T 细胞效应器功能,以防止致命的免疫病理学,但代价是病毒控制。该免疫神经轴将 宿主 行为和 抗病毒药物 免疫集成到单个调节回路中。资金来源 不适用 主题类别 神经免疫学 (NEUR)

news.content: ___ Vanguard News Home News Top Stories Politics Metro Business Sports Editorial Columns ALLURE E-editions Search for: Home News Top Stories Politics Metro Business Sports Editorial Columns ALLURE E-editions Home News Politics Metro Business Sports Editorial Columns Allure E-Editions Home » Health » Lassa fever death toll hits 229 as fresh infections rise Health Follow us on Google July 26, 2026 Lassa fever death toll hits 229 as fresh infections rise ...NCDC records 25 new cases in one week, healthcare worker infected By Chioma Obinna Nigeria’s Lassa fever outbreak has claimed 229 lives this year, with the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, NCDC, confirming a fresh spike in infections as 25 new cases were recorded in one week across five states. The latest Lassa Fever Situation Report for Epidemiological Week 28 showed that confirmed cases rose from 14 in Week 27 to 25 in Week 28, with new infections reported in Ondo, Bauchi, Edo, Kogi and Cross River states. The report also revealed that the country has recorded 963 confirmed cases out of 6,554 suspected infections between Weeks 1 and 28, while the case fatality rate, CFR, stood at 23.8 per cent, significantly higher than the 18.7 per cent recorded during the same period in 2025. Unfortunately, one healthcare worker was infected during the reporting week, underscoring the continued occupational risks facing frontline health personnel battling the outbreak. According to the NCDC, 23 states and 114 Local Government Areas have reported at least one confirmed case this year, with Ondo, Bauchi, Taraba, Edo and Benue accounting for 86 per cent of all confirmed infections nationwide. The agency said Ondo alone contributed 31 per cent of confirmed cases, followed by Bauchi with 25 per cent, Taraba 14 per cent, Edo 10 per cent, and Benue with six per cent. The report showed that young adults remain the most affected population, with people aged 21 to 30 years accounting for the highest number of confirmed infections. Patients ranged from one to 93 years, with a median age of 30 years. The NCDC attributed the persistently high death rate to late presentation of patients at health facilities, poor health-seeking behaviour driven partly by the high cost of treatment, poor environmental sanitation in high-burden communities and inadequate public awareness of the disease. The agency warned healthcare workers to maintain a high index of suspicion for Lassa fever and ensure early diagnosis and prompt referral of suspected cases. Related News Resident doctors issue final deadline, threaten nationwide strike from Aug 10 Benue records 193 Hepatitis B cases among pregnant women, moves to curb spread 9 million still miss HIV treatment - WHO agement, infection prevention and control, laboratory diagnosis, risk communication and community engagement. Among recent interventions, the agency said it trained frontline healthcare workers with support from the World Health Organization, Africa CDC, Médecins Sans Frontières, FHI 360 and other partners; deployed National Rapid Response Teams to seven high-burden states; strengthened infection prevention programmes in endemic states; distributed personal protective equipment to health facilities; and conducted community sensitisation campaigns targeting farmers, market women, religious and traditional leaders. The agency also disclosed that a 30-day Healthcare Worker Protection Plan had been developed to reduce infections among frontline personnel, while updated infection prevention guidelines had been circulated nationwide. The NCDC reiterated that early presentation at health facilities remains critical to survival, urging Nigerians to seek immediate medical attention for persistent fever or symptoms suggestive of Lassa fever, especially in endemic areas. It called on state governments and partners to strengthen surveillance, improve public awareness and sustain coordinated response efforts to curb further spread of the disease. news.title_zh: 随着新感染病例的增加,拉沙热 死亡人数达到 229 人 - Vanguard News
news.source_body_en: Nigeria is experiencing a severe Lassa fever outbreak with 229 deaths and 963 confirmed cases as of Week 28, 2026. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) reports a 23.8% case fatality rate, significantly higher than the previous year. New infections continue to rise, with 25 confirmed cases in the latest week across five states, including one healthcare worker infection. Young adults aged 21-30 are most affected, with cases spanning all ages. The outbreak has spread to 23 states, with Ondo, Bauchi, Taraba, Edo, and Benue accounting for 86% of cases. Despite interventions like rapid response teams, healthcare worker training, and community awareness campaigns, challenges persist due to late patient presentation, high treatment costs, and poor sanitation. The NCDC urges early medical consultation and strengthened surveillance to curb further spread.

news.content: Skip to main content Sister Publication Links GenomeWeb 360Dx Precision Medicine Online PMLS Events Premium Trial: Request an Annual Quote User account menu My 360Dx Profile Newsletters My Topics Reading List Log out Log in Subscribe Menu Close Menu Main navigation My 360Dx Profile Newsletters My Topics Reading List Log out Business & Policy Business News Research Funding Policy & Legislation Regulatory News Reimbursement Clinical Lab Management Diagnostics Molecular Diagnostics Immunoassays Tissue-Based Testing Clinical Chemistry Hematology/Coagulation Point-of-Care Testing Companion Diagnostics Disease Areas Cancer Infectious Disease Cardiovascular Disease Neurological & Psychological Disease Autoimmune Disease Inherited Disease Reproductive Health Respiratory Gastrointestinal COVID-19 Resources Webinars White Papers Job Listings New Products People in the News FDA 510(k) Tracker: IVD Tests and Instruments Coronavirus Test Tracker Partner Content Breadcrumb Home Diagnostics Point-of-Care Testing Premium Trial: Request an Annual Quote Log in Subscribe Alveo Technologies, University of Texas Partner on Lassa Virus Test Jul 29, 2026 | staff reporter Premium Save for later NEW YORK — Alveo Technologies said on Wednesday that it has partnered with the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB) to develop a molecular point-of-care diagnostic for Lassa fever. The hemorrhagic illness is caused by the Lassa virus and is predominantly found in West Africa, where access to testing laboratories is limited. Under their collaboration, Alveo and UTMB plan to evaluate the diagnostic at clinical sites in Nigeria and Sierra Leone. "There is a clear and immediate need for a reliable point-of-care diagnostic for Lassa fever," UTMB researcher Courtney Woolsey said in a statement. "Having immediate diagnostic capabilities at our field sites will fundamentally change how we respond to Lassa fever cases in affected communities." Alveo's technology uses a combination of isothermal amplification and electrical impedance sensing technology in a cartridge-based design for rapid POC pathogen detection. In addition to their Lassa virus partnership, Alveo and UTMB are also working together to validate the company's molecular testing technologies in environmentally or geographically challenging settings, the Alameda, California-based company said. Specifically, they are collaborating on field testing of Alveo's Sense Poultry platform for avian influenza surveillance in Peru, as well as the company's platform under maximum biosafety conditions at the UTMB's Galveston National Laboratory. Financial and other terms of the arrangement were not disclosed.
